# External Integrations
<!-- docs.AI knowledge doc — auto-generated by speckit.init -->

## Tracker Integrations

Skills in `skills/ai-radija-tracker-*/` create and update work items in the configured tracker. Each project uses exactly one tracker, configured in `CLAUDE.md` under `## Tracker`.

### Azure DevOps (REST API 7.1)
- **Skill**: `ai-radija-tracker-ado`
- **Hierarchy**: Epic → Feature → Story (PBI) → Task
- **Auth**: PAT token or `az login` (Azure CLI)
- **Description format**: HTML (rich text)
- **Test integration**: Creates Test Case work items with Given/When/Then → ADO step format
- **Config keys**: `org`, `project`, `pat`, `iteration`

### Jira Cloud (REST API v3)
- **Skill**: `ai-radija-tracker-jira`
- **Hierarchy**: Epic → Story → Sub-task
- **Auth**: API token + email, or Atlassian MCP
- **Description format**: ADF (Atlassian Document Format)
- **Config keys**: `host`, `project`, `email`, `token`

### GitHub Issues (gh CLI + REST API)
- **Skill**: `ai-radija-tracker-github`
- **Hierarchy**: Labels encode hierarchy (epic, feature, story, task)
- **Auth**: `gh auth login` or `GITHUB_TOKEN`
- **Description format**: Markdown
- **Config keys**: `owner`, `repo`, `token` (optional if gh is authenticated)

### Linear (GraphQL API)
- **Skill**: `ai-radija-tracker-linear`
- **Hierarchy**: Issues + Sub-issues, Cycles for sprints
- **Auth**: Linear MCP or API key
- **Description format**: Markdown
- **Config keys**: `team_id`, `api_key`

### Notion (REST API + MCP)
- **Skill**: `ai-radija-tracker-notion`
- **Hierarchy**: Database pages with relation properties
- **Auth**: Notion MCP (preferred) or integration token
- **Description format**: Notion block format
- **Config keys**: `database_id`, `token`
- **Caveat**: Relies on some undocumented endpoints; may drift across API versions.

---

## Tracker Setup Skill

`ai-radija-tracker-setup` — interactive wizard that asks which tracker to use, collects credentials, and writes the `## Tracker` section to `CLAUDE.md`.

---

## Knowledge Generation (Internal)

`ai-radija-generate-pre-knowledge-docs` — reads the project codebase and generates the `docs.AI/` suite. No external API calls; purely local file analysis.

---

## Radija Regulatory Templates

`skills/ai-radija-bootstrap/templates/regulations/` contains country-specific compliance Markdown templates:

| Country | Regulation |
|---------|-----------|
| Brazil | LGPD |
| Mexico | LFPDPPP |
| Colombia | Ley 1581 |
| (others) | Varies |

These are baked-in reference documents, not live API integrations.
